evidence.title: ElevenLabs adds section-by-section song editing to ElevenMusic, as Suno, Udio, and Google build out rival tools - Music Business Worldwide

name: ElevenLabs adds section-by-section song editing to ElevenMusic
summary: News piece on ElevenLabs' Composer, a tool that regenerates single sections of AI-generated songs without touching the rest.
description: Music Business Worldwide report (August 27, 2026) on the launch of Composer in ElevenLabs' ElevenMusic platform: rewrite a verse, slow a bridge or move a chorus to another key with per-section style, tempo, energy, instrumentation and length controls, compare several takes of a section, and reorder song structure. It sets the release against Suno Studio 2.0, Google's Flow Music and Udio, and recaps the licensing deals and lawsuits around AI music.
contains: news article, 27 August 2026, by Mandy Dalugdug
covers ElevenMusic Composer: per-section regeneration, multiple takes, structure reordering
context on Suno Studio 2.0, Google Flow Music, Udio and label licensing deals
tags: news, United States, AI Music, Artificial Intelligence, ElevenLabs
